name: Spreading Oleaster
desc: Spreading Oleaster (Elaeagnus umbellata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Elaeagnus umbellata is a species of flowering plant known as Japanese silverberry, umbellata oleaster, autumn olive, autumn elaeagnus, spreading oleaster, autumnberry, or autumn berry.
